hypothesis: In a finite task with fixed hard-verification gates, a joint policy can choose observation when type information changes the best action and skip it when its opportunity cost consumes a more valuable recovery reserve.
method: Exact enumeration of a small declared probability model; all quantities are synthetic and illustrative, not calibrated.

model.verification: mandatory exact readback before terminal success credit; never traded against utility

decision: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if candidate values match independent exhaustive policy enumeration, chooses observation in informative case and skips it in weak-signal case under the equal 4-opportunity horizon, and hard verification is never omitted; otherwise FAIL_METHOD.
scope: This fixture tests only accounting and policy ranking under declared transitions. It cannot support GUI/runtime probability, safety-rate, latency, model, or product claims.
